boarding_points.name: Marina Bay Cruise Centre Singapore (MBCCS)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: 2 cruise berths up to 360m + tender float
boarding_points.charging_potential: Heavy industrial shore power; pedestal retrofit for small craft requires concession-holder cooperation (closing window per SG city file)
boarding_points.notes: Highest-visibility demo zone under Istana/PMO overlook; MPA-controlled; cruise tender float used by superyachts and large-craft transfers. Front door for any Marina Bay anchor pilot.

boarding_points.name: Marina South Pier
boarding_points.operator: MPA (Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Public passenger pier; multiple floating finger berths; Singapore Island Cruise + private water-taxi concessions
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closing — MPA legacy pier; pedestal retrofit hard but in scope of any MPA sandbox first-of-class deployment. Marina South substation grid capacity ample.
boarding_points.notes: Primary public-ferry gateway to Southern Islands (St John's, Kusu, Lazarus) and OPL anchorage transfers. The natural Pioneer II Marina Bay anchor pier if MPA cooperates.

boarding_points.name: Clifford Pier / The Fullerton Bay
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Heritage pier converted to F&B + adjacent Fullerton Bay Hotel jetty for hotel-private transfers
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — heritage-listed structure; charging would require greenfield satellite pontoon
boarding_points.notes: Iconic Lion-City heritage pier; high-tier demo arrival point for hotel guests and corporate VIPs. Frequently used as informal yacht boarding under Fullerton concession.

boarding_points.name: One Fullerton / Merlion Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Short floating pontoon used for tour boats + occasional event jetty
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — symbolic civic frontage; URA gate
boarding_points.notes: Best photo-arrival point in all of SG (Merlion backdrop). Politically sensitive Istana-axis overlook. Suitable for marquee demo but not routine ops.

boarding_points.name: Bayfront / MBS Event Pontoon
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Event pontoon active during NDP / F1 / Singapore Maritime Week
boarding_points.charging_potential: Event-only; no permanent pedestal but greenfield-spec-in window during SMW
boarding_points.notes: Event-only floating pontoon used by MBS for arrivals and NDP boat-segment staging. Demo-window only.

boarding_points.name: HarbourFront Centre Ferry Terminal (Singapore Cruise Centre)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: 6 ferry berths; primary regional fast-ferry terminal — Batam (Sekupang, Batam Centre, Harbour Bay, Waterfront), Bintan (BBT), Karimun
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed-retrofit — Temasek concession + customs/immigration infrastructure; pedestal retrofit pending MPA 2030 electrification mandate trigger
boarding_points.notes: Workhorse of the SG↔Indonesian Riau corridor (~5M+ pax/yr pre-COVID). The Pioneer II routine cross-border #11 candidate physical anchor on SG side. Sindo / Batam Fast / Majestic / Horizon incumbents berth here.

boarding_points.name: Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: 4 ferry berths; Bintan Resorts (Bandar Bentan Telani) + Batam Nongsapura primary route
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed-retrofit; isolation from East Coast grid moderate but capacity available
boarding_points.notes: The Bintan-resort gateway (Banyan Tree / Angsana / Nirwana / The Sanchaya). Closer to Changi Airport than HarbourFront — strategic for fly-and-cruise hospitality wedge. Bintan Resorts (Salim/Keppel-historic) controls demand side.

boarding_points.name: Changi Ferry Terminal
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: 2 berths; Tanjung Belungkor (Desaru) RoPax route
boarding_points.charging_potential: Open-to-greenfield — under-utilized; pedestal retrofit feasible if SDC/MPA prioritize
boarding_points.notes: RoPax to Desaru — the underused niche cross-border MY leisure route. Quanta-LR / Pioneer II edge candidate to Desaru ~25–30 nm.

boarding_points.name: Changi Point Ferry Terminal
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Bumboat berths for Pulau Ubin + Pengerang (MY Johor — Tanjung Pengelih) heritage cross-border
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — heritage-protected pier; very small footprint
boarding_points.notes: Heritage bumboat hub to Pulau Ubin. Pengerang cross-border informal route. Ops/training water only at scale.

boarding_points.name: Marina at Keppel Bay
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: 168 berths up to 80m superyacht
boarding_points.charging_potential: Open-retrofit — Keppel as a counterparty; sovereign-adjacent (Temasek). 50A pedestals standard, 480V 3-phase feasible at end-of-pier slots.
boarding_points.notes: Keppel Land as counterparty is the cleanest sovereign-adjacent commercial marina on SG mainland. Reflections at Keppel Bay residential overlay; convenient to CBD via Telok Blangah. Strong Pioneer II base candidate.

boarding_points.name: ONE°15 Marina Sentosa Cove
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: 270 berths up to 200ft + members club + hotel
boarding_points.charging_potential: Open — cleanest open pedestal-spec window in SG per city file; SUTL receptive to electrification narrative; sovereign-adjacent via founder Arthur Tay relationships
boarding_points.notes: 5-anchor (Asia Pacific Boating). Largest premium private marina in SG. Sentosa Cove luxury-residential overlay; Royal Albatross / yacht-charter incumbent. Headline Pioneer II base candidate.

boarding_points.name: Raffles Marina
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: 194 wet berths + dry stack; lock + lighthouse-clubhouse
boarding_points.charging_potential: Open — independent operator, willing counterparty; diesel-refuel already present (Quanta-LR ready); pedestal retrofit feasible
boarding_points.notes: Westernmost SG marina; ~4 nm from Malaysian waters (Tuas Second Link). Natural Tuas/Jurong B2B + JB cross-border departure point. Diesel-refuel logistics in place = Quanta-LR-ready.

boarding_points.name: Republic of Singapore Yacht Club (RSYC)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: 147 berths + dry stack; ~200-year heritage club
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — heritage member-driven governance; long lead for pedestal change
boarding_points.notes: Oldest yacht club in SE Asia (est. 1826). Membership-led governance; slow to spec but high prestige. Marquee endorsement candidate.

boarding_points.name: Changi Sailing Club
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Moorings + dinghy fleet; ~600 members
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — heritage members' club
boarding_points.notes: Small dinghy/keelboat-focused club; not commercial scale. Useful for ops/training water and east-coast familiarisation.

boarding_points.name: SAF Yacht Club @ Changi
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Members-only military-affiliated; ~80 berths
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — MINDEF gate
boarding_points.notes: MINDEF-affiliated; defense-channel relationship potential (parallel to Navier Defense narrative) but not commercial. Hide-equivalent for commercial use; surface only via MINDEF channel.

boarding_points.name: SAF Yacht Club @ Sembawang
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Members-only; ~70 berths
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — MINDEF gate
boarding_points.notes: North-coast Johor-Strait access; primarily of interest as MINDEF channel; not commercial route.

boarding_points.name: Marina Country Club @ Punggol / Punggol Marina
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: ~80 berths; small craft
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed-retrofit — small operator
boarding_points.notes: Punggol-area private marina; serves north-east HDB waterfront residents. Adjacent to Coney Island. Not a strategic Pioneer II anchor but useful east-coast lily-pad.

boarding_points.name: Punggol Point Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Heritage timber jetty; non-commercial
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — heritage
boarding_points.notes: Heritage WWII-era timber jetty; Coney Island gateway. Demo / heritage tourism only.

boarding_points.name: St John's Island Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Public ferry pier + research-station berth (Tropical Marine Science Institute, NUS)
boarding_points.charging_potential: Greenfield — Southern Islands all under SDC concession; born-island microgrid candidate; clean Pioneer II pedestal design-in window
boarding_points.notes: Anchor southern-islands stop. NUS TMSI research station overlay = science-mission narrative. Quarantine-island heritage. Connected to Lazarus Island via causeway — combined visitor magnet.

boarding_points.name: Lazarus Island Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Beach landing + small jetty; no formal terminal yet
boarding_points.charging_potential: Greenfield — SDC Lazarus masterplan in active design 2026–28; pre-spec pedestal design-in window OPEN
boarding_points.notes: Beach-club-led Southern Islands premium destination. The cleanest greenfield resort-island design-in window in SG. SDC actively planning a private-resort future for Lazarus. Navier Experience anchor candidate.

validation_log.geocode_name: Singapore Island Cruise & Ferry Services | St John's/Lazarus, Kusu & Sisters' Island

boarding_points.name: Kusu Island Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Public ferry jetty; Tua Pek Kong temple + Malay kramat shrines
boarding_points.charging_potential: Greenfield — same SDC concession window as St John's / Lazarus
boarding_points.notes: Religious-pilgrimage island (Kusu festival ~9th lunar month draws ~100K visitors). Cultural overlay = quiet-mode + low-wake positioning.

boarding_points.name: Sisters' Islands Marine Park Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Small jetty; permit-controlled access
boarding_points.charging_potential: Greenfield — NParks-controlled; quiet-mode + low-wake positioning lever (born-protected overlay)
boarding_points.notes: Singapore's ONLY marine park. Pioneer II Half-Foil + Quanta-LR quiet-mode = park-permitted access wedge. NParks is a second regulatory channel parallel to MPA/SDC.

boarding_points.name: Pulau Hantu Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Small jetty; dive-charter pickup point
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — refinery-adjacent industrial seascape (Bukom)
boarding_points.notes: Popular wreck-dive / nudibranch site; the only meaningful dive-pickup jetty in SG itself. Sits next to Pulau Bukom (Shell refinery) — visual context matters.

boarding_points.name: Tanjong Beach Club / Sentosa Cove Waterfront
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Beach landing + adjacent SDC-controlled waterfront refresh planning
boarding_points.charging_potential: Open-greenfield — SDC waterfront refresh design-in window per city file
boarding_points.notes: Premium beach club; greenfield SDC waterfront refresh = clean Pioneer II co-design hook. Sentosa Cove luxury-residential frontage.

boarding_points.name: Capella Singapore (Sentosa) — Private Arrival Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Hotel-private small landing (limited)
boarding_points.charging_potential: Open — Pontiac Land hospitality counterparty; sovereign-adjacent (Kwee family); cleanest premium-hotel design-in
boarding_points.notes: Pontiac Land HQ-locus; Capella brand globally. Premium-arrival narrative. Trump-Kim 2018 summit venue → political-overlook overlay.

boarding_points.name: Resorts World Sentosa Waterfront
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Resort marina-adjacent landing + cruise transfer use
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed-retrofit — Genting concession; possible negotiation under SG IR-2.0 expansion
boarding_points.notes: Integrated resort; mass-market + premium dual SKU. RWS IR-2.0 expansion (~2026–30) creates partial greenfield re-spec window.

boarding_points.name: W Singapore — Sentosa Cove (Quayside Isle)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Adjacent to ONE°15 berths (Quayside Isle dining frontage)
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — uses ONE°15 berthing
boarding_points.notes: Hospitality co-tenant of ONE°15. Counted secondary because boarding shares ONE°15.

boarding_points.name: Sofitel Singapore Sentosa Resort & Spa
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Beachfront access; no formal jetty
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — bluff-top hotel, beach-only access
boarding_points.notes: Limited boarding feasibility (cliff-top resort); tender-transfer only. Secondary.

boarding_points.name: Fullerton Bay Hotel Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Hotel-private floating pontoon at Clifford Pier rear
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed-retrofit — heritage-adjacent
boarding_points.notes: Sister property to Clifford Pier; uses adjacent pontoon for hotel-private water transfers and weddings. CBD-facing.

boarding_points.name: Pulau Ubin Jetty (Ubin village)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Bumboat berths; heritage timber
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — heritage-protected; very low priority
boarding_points.notes: Heritage kampong island; bumboat ferry from Changi Point. Conservation overlay; no commercial Pioneer II ops, only demo/ops training.

boarding_points.name: Pulau Tekong Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Military-only landing craft
boarding_points.charging_potential: n/a — closed military zone
boarding_points.notes: hide-commercial-only / MINDEF Basic Military Training Centre island; no civilian access. Defense-channel reference only.

boarding_points.name: Pulau Semakau Landfill Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Industrial barge berth; NEA-operated
boarding_points.charging_potential: n/a — industrial
boarding_points.notes: hide-commercial-only — NEA landfill, restricted access. Has surprising biodiversity (eco-tour permits) but not a passenger boarding option.

boarding_points.name: Jurong Island Banyan Basin Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Industrial + crew-transfer berths (Shell, ExxonMobil, etc.)
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — industrial concession; possible via JTC if crew-transfer SKU is framed
boarding_points.notes: B2B crew-transfer wedge candidate (refinery / petrochemical workforce). JTC counterparty. Industrial security overlay.

boarding_points.name: MPA Pilot Boarding / West Tuas
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Pilot-vessel berths supporting Singapore Strait pilotage
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — MPA operational base
boarding_points.notes: MPA pilot-craft staging. Relevant only as reference for MPA-operated infrastructure visibility; not passenger.

boarding_points.name: Tuas Mega Port (PSA)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: World's largest fully-automated container terminal under buildout to 2040
boarding_points.charging_potential: n/a — container terminal
boarding_points.notes: hide-commercial-only. PSA Temasek-anchor relevance to Navier as parent-shareholder narrative is high but boarding-point-wise irrelevant.

boarding_points.name: Keppel Bay Marina Bridge / Caribbean at Keppel Bay
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Residential-marina frontage at Reflections / Caribbean at Keppel Bay
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — residential pedestal regime
boarding_points.notes: Secondary residential-front marina alongside Marina at Keppel Bay (same operator).

boarding_points.name: Quayside Isle Pontoon (Sentosa Cove)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Short event/visitor pontoon; arrival-by-boat F&B concept
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — uses ONE°15 power
boarding_points.notes: F&B-arrival pontoon at Sentosa Cove waterfront; demo-grade visibility for premium-arrival narrative.

boarding_points.name: Seatrium (ex-Sembcorp Marine) — Crew Boarding
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Crew-transfer berths at yard frontage
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — yard concession; possible local-build partner narrative
boarding_points.notes: Seatrium = potential local-fab partner for Navier SEA build. Yard frontage as a crew-transfer testbed.

boarding_points.name: Penguin International — Tuas Shipyard
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Fast-craft yard berths; crew-boat newbuild specialist
boarding_points.charging_potential: Greenfield — Penguin known fast-craft builder; partnership-relevant
boarding_points.notes: Credible local-fab partner (city file). Ex-operator of Penguin Express SG↔Batam/Bintan 1990s–2000s fast-ferry. Industrial relationship anchor, not passenger.

boarding_points.name: ST Engineering Marine — Jurong Yard
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Naval/defense + commercial yard
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — defense-controlled access
boarding_points.notes: Defense-channel local-build partner; Navier Defense-Valkyrie narrative anchor. Industrial only, not passenger boarding.

boarding_points.name: Strategic Marine — Tuas Yard
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Crew-boat + CTV newbuild yard
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — yard concession
boarding_points.notes: Third credible SG fast-craft builder (CTV / crew-boat). Local-build optionality.

boarding_points.name: Pulau Brani Terminal (legacy + future Greater Southern Waterfront)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Ex-container terminal; future ~2030+ greenfield URA masterplan
boarding_points.charging_potential: Greenfield — URA's largest waterfront masterplan in SG, with pedestal-spec design-in window OPEN through buildout
boarding_points.notes: URA Greater Southern Waterfront masterplan = the long-horizon greenfield wedge per city file. Pulau Brani decommissioning + Sentosa-Brani link makes this the singular SG urban-water greenfield design-in opportunity.

boarding_points.name: Marina Bay Floating Platform (The Float / NS Square)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Largest floating stage globally; event use (NDP, F1)
boarding_points.charging_potential: Event-only — NS Square 2027 redevelopment will replace; possible greenfield design-in
boarding_points.notes: Most iconic floating platform in SG; redevelopment as NS Square 2027 = greenfield-spec moment. Demo-visibility unmatched.

boarding_points.name: MPA Maritime Drone Estate (Marina South) — Floating Living Lab
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Permitted autonomy-and-electrification testbed water (per MPA Maritime Drone Estate / Maritime Single Window programmes)
boarding_points.charging_potential: Greenfield — purpose-designed MPA innovation test water; the canonical SEA sandbox cert-anchor instantiation
boarding_points.notes: MPA's actual sandbox water — the single most strategic boarding/test point for first-of-class certification cascade. MPA-anchored convening venue Singapore Maritime Week. Directly aligned with cert-anchor cascade (ID/MY/TH/PH downstream acceptance).

boarding_points.name: Changi Naval Base
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Naval base; US Navy logistical hub
boarding_points.charging_potential: n/a — defense
boarding_points.notes: hide-commercial-only. Defense reference for Valkyrie / interceptor narrative.

boarding_points.name: Marina Bay Water Taxi Stops (MPA pilot — Esplanade / Bayfront / Promontory)
boarding_points.operator: MPA / WaterB / Singapore River Cruise (concession-operated stops)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Series of small floating taxi docks at Esplanade, Bayfront, Merlion, Promontory
boarding_points.charging_potential: Open-spec — MPA pilot stops are exactly the BTM/MPA-designated water taxi pilot programme referenced in the city brief; greenfield-spec design-in window OPEN
boarding_points.notes: MPA-designated water-taxi pilot stops on Marina Bay; matches city brief 'new BTM/MPA-designated water taxi pilot stops'. Most direct retrofit opportunity for Pioneer II Marina Bay anchor.

boarding_points.name: Singapore River Cruise Jetties (Clarke Quay / Boat Quay / Robertson Quay)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Bumboat stops at Clarke Quay, Boat Quay, Robertson Quay, Marina Bay loop
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closing — bumboat fleet already targeted by MPA 2030 electrification mandate; concrete electrification pilot in progress; pedestal retrofit committed
boarding_points.notes: The scheduled water-bus network on Singapore River — the SG analog to Dubai RTA Water Bus. MPA 2030 mandate electrification means concrete pedestal retrofit underway. Strong fleet-renewal wedge.

boarding_points.name: Bedok Jetty (East Coast Park)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Public fishing/recreation jetty; no formal berthing
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — recreation only
boarding_points.notes: Iconic East Coast Park jetty; no passenger boarding today but could be retrofitted in future as East Coast water-taxi extension if MPA pilot expands eastward.

boarding_points.name: Bukit Chermin / Labrador Boardwalk Jetty
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Heritage boardwalk; informal small-craft access
boarding_points.charging_potential: Closed — heritage
boarding_points.notes: Heritage boardwalk linking Labrador Park / Reflections to Keppel Bay. Demo arrival point only.

boarding_points.name: Pasir Panjang / GSW future cruise & marina cluster
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: Future cruise + small-craft cluster within GSW masterplan post-2027 container relocation
boarding_points.charging_potential: Greenfield — full GSW masterplan opens pedestal-spec window through 2030+
boarding_points.notes: GSW container-terminal-to-waterfront-transformation creates a 30-year-rolling pedestal greenfield. Long-horizon. Pair with Pulau Brani entry.

boarding_points.name: Marina at Keppel Bay — Superyacht Berths (extension)
boarding_points.berths_or_capacity: End-of-pier slots accommodating up to 80m superyachts
boarding_points.charging_potential: Open — 3-phase end-of-pier feasible
boarding_points.notes: Secondary entry for the superyacht end of MKB — used as primary superyacht berthing in CBD-Sentosa axis. Distinct boarding mode from main MKB entry for ultra-premium transfers.

boarding_points.name: Marina East Waterfront (East Coast ↔ CBD gateway)
boarding_points.notes: East-Coast↔CBD commuter water gateway. Landlocked Singapore is investing proactively in efficient transport infrastructure; a fast foiling East Coast↔Marina Bay line is a compelling MPA/LTA urban-mobility case. Adjacent to Marina East Drive and the future Long Island reclamation.

boarding_points.name: East Coast Park Area C (Marine Parade / Katong waterfront)
boarding_points.notes: East Coast residential catchment (Marine Parade/Katong) seafront access point for an East Coast↔CBD foiling commuter line.
